rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Trust Score computes a 0–100 trust rating for domains, Ethereum wallet addresses, and APIs by analyzing SSL certificates, DNS records, WHOIS data, and HTTP security headers. Returns a structured score with component breakdown. Paid per call in USDC on the Base blockchain via the x402 micropayment protocol.
